content.title: Michigan-Arizona: Listen to the Live Radio Broadcast (4/4/26)
content.text: As March Madness® continues with the Final Four® today, listen live as the Michigan Wolverines face off against the Arizona Wildcats. How to Listen to the Live Radio Broadcast Beginning Saturday, April 4, at 8:49pm ET, SiriusXM listeners can hear live play-by-play of the game in English on satellite channel 84 and in Spanish on satellite channel 201, or on the SiriusXM app with a smart device. Related: Illinois Fighting Illini vs. UConn Huskies: Listen on SiriusXM More College Basketball on SiriusXM SiriusXM delivers extensive, coast-to-coast coverage of NCAA® March Madness®, offering college basketball fans the most thrilling month of the season. Get access to every game of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball Championship. Coverage for the 2026 NCAA Division I Women’s Basketball Championship includes every game starting with the Sweet 16, running through the championship game, plus several early round matchups. The men’s tournament begins with the First Four® on March 17–18 and continues through the Men’s Final Four® semifinal and National Championship game on April 4 and 6 in Indianapolis, IN. The NCAA Division I Women’s Basketball Championship runs from the First Four matchups on March 18–19 through the Women’s Final Four semifinal and National Championship game, to be played April 3 and 5 in Phoenix, AZ. Learn more about college basketball on SiriusXM and start listening today.
